definitions.gloss: emergency; time of crisis; state of emergency
definitions.explanation: A period when normal conditions break down and extraordinary measures are needed, such as a disaster, war, or serious accident. Used of the situation as a whole rather than of a single incident.

examples.japanese: {非常時|ひじょうじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{備|そな}える→備える：02125_sonaeru⟧。
{非常時|ひじょうじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{階段|かいだん}→階段：00782_kaidan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: In an emergency, please use these stairs.

examples.japanese: {非常時|ひじょうじ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{一度|いちど}→一度：01312_ichido⟧⟦{訓練|くんれん}→訓練：02673_kunren⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}っている→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: We hold a drill once a year on how to respond in an emergency.

examples.japanese: ⟦{平常時|へいじょうじ}→平常時：30259_heijouji⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{非常時|ひじょうじ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{判断|はんだん}→判断：03571_handan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{基準|きじゅん}→基準：00228_kijun⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧まったく⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧。
examples.english: The criteria for making decisions are completely different in normal times and in an emergency.

notes:
⟦{非常|ひじょう}→非常：01598_hijou⟧ (extraordinary, emergency) + ⟦{時|じ}→時：09869_ji⟧ (time). The word names the *period* of crisis, so it is usually followed by ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ or ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ rather than used as the subject of a sentence.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {非常時|ひじょうじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{備|そな}える→備える：02125_sonaeru⟧: to prepare for an emergency
- {非常時|ひじょうじ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧: emergency response
- {非常時|ひじょうじ}⟦{用|よう}→〜用：09842_you⟧: for emergency use
- {非常時|ひじょうじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{想定|そうてい}する→想定する：19018_souteisuru⟧: to assume an emergency scenario

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{緊急事態|きんきゅうじたい}→緊急事態：16936_kinkyuujitai⟧: state of emergency — more official, used of formally declared emergencies
- ⟦{有事|ゆうじ}→有事：13078_yuuji⟧: contingency, armed emergency — mainly military or national-security contexts
- ⟦{平常時|へいじょうじ}→平常時：30259_heijouji⟧: normal times — the standard opposite, often paired with it
